messages:
maria: Quick sync — handing off routing QoS metrics for the per-route SLO dashboard. Need infra + runtime inputs so Console can surface P50/P95/P99, TTFT, and tokens/sec by model+route. Short thread to coordinate who owns what.

sanjay: Will runtime be emitting separate metrics per route or is this a tagging problem?

ryan: Runtime will emit latency histograms and tokens counters, but we currently tag by model_name and route_key. We can add route_variant and capacity_tier if necessary. Concern: cardinality spike.

kevin: Cardinality is the big thing — route_key has ~3k values for internal experiments. We should avoid creating dashboards that explode series. Propose: only surface top-N active routes and allow ad-hoc queries.

anya: From Console UX side we want filterable dropdowns: model, route (top-N), variant, and a toggle for 'show all routes' with a warning. Also need TTFT (time to first token) as a separate panel.

maria: Ideal metric list for Console (what we expect from runtime/ingest):
```
model.latency.histogram{route_key,model_name,model_variant,capacity_tier}  -> p50/p95/p99
model.ttft.histogram{route_key,model_name,model_variant}
model.tokens.count{route_key,model_name} -> tokens/sec (rate over 1m)
route.request.count{route_key, outcome, fallback_route}
```
If any of the tags are too high-cardinality, tell us which ones and we'll adjust UX.

ryan: We can emit those. Implementation notes: histograms use HDR on the runtime side. We already have model_name+route_key as tags. Adding model_variant and capacity_tier is cheap. But we should add route sampling for routes with <1r/min to avoid a ton of empty series.

kevin: Agree on sampling. Also recommend generating a derived metric for 'route_topness' (e.g., top-100 by qps) and only enable route_key tag for those; fallback to aggregated "other_routes" bucket.

anya: That works. Console will show an "Other (N routes)" row with drill-in only if requested. UX will include an inline tooltip explaining sampling and cardinality.

sanjay: Telemetry/ingest question: do we want raw histograms or precomputed P95/P99 aggregates? Precomputed reduces storage and query cost.

ryan: We prefer raw histograms from runtime (HDR buckets) then compute Pxx at query time for flexibility. But we can emit precomputed p50/p95/p99 counters as a light-weight fallback for Console's default view.

maria: TL;DR plan: runtime emits histograms + optional precomputed p50/p95/p99; ingest applies top-N route sampling and creates derived 'other_routes' rollup. Console consumes both histogram and precomputed series and defaults to precomputed for quick load.

kevin: Alerts/SLAs: where do alerts live? Eng-oncall wants per-model SLO alerts but per-route SLAs for high-tier customers. Recommend separate alerting streams: model-level infra alerts (eng-sre) and customer route alerts (product).

anya: Console will surface SLO panel and an "open alert" link that deep-links to alert config. We'll need a mapping from route_key -> customer_id for the link. Privacy note: some route_keys are PII-mapped, need hashed mapping stored in the config service.

maria: Good catch. Ryan/Infra: can you add a hashed_route_id tag to the telemetry or provide a mapping endpoint?

ryan: We can add hashed_route_id in the ingest layer, not runtime. It will be a low-cardinality mapping (customer -> hashed) and safe. Will take a day to implement.

dev-bot: Deploy started: telemetry-ingest@release/2026-03-18 09:12 UTC (sha: a1b2c3).

kevin: One more constraint — quotas. The dashboard should show per-route quota burn rate (tokens/sec vs quota limit). Which metric should we use?

maria: Use model.tokens.count as numerator and route_quota.tokens_limit (ingest as a gauge per route refreshed from Quota API) as denominator. We'll expose "quota_utilization" = rate(tokens)/quota_limit.

anya: UI note: add a red band on panels where quota_utilization > 0.9 and a small embedded CTA to request quota increase.

sanjay: For TTFT calculation, what window? First token latency per request, aggregate as histogram. For charting use median + p95 over 1m rate windows.

ryan: Confirmed. We'll emit model.ttft.histogram with per-request first_token_ms. Ingest will keep 1m and 5m summaries.

maria: Action items: 
- ryan: add model_variant, capacity_tier tags + hashed_route_id in ingest; enable HDR histograms and optional precomputed pxx counters (ETA 1d)
- kevin: implement top-N route selection logic and 'other_routes' rollup in the metrics aggregation layer (ETA 2d)
- anya: Console panels & UX: top-N dropdown, TTFT panel, quota_utilization band, drill-in experience (ETA 3d)
- sanjay: confirm alert routing mapping and SLO thresholds with eng-sre + product (ETA 2d)

maria: I'll run a quick handoff doc after this thread and queue a sync if anyone hits blockers. Thanks all :raised_hands:

kevin: Sounds good. Leaving notes in the eng-platform channel for visibility.

ryan: If we hit cardinality surprises, we should throttle tag emission at runtime and move tag enrichment to a low-throughput path. Noted.

anya: I'll mock up the dashboard panels and post screenshots in this thread when ready.

maria: End of thread — I'll post the handoff doc shortly.
